en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide unpaved road lined with young trees (Rue Evangelistria) leading toward a distant cityscape with low buildings and a fortified hill in the background. A solitary figure stands in the middle of the road. At the top there is handwritten text in an Ottoman-style script. At the bottom, printed captions in Greek and French identify the view as Evangelistria Street in Salonique (Thessaloniki). The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears on the right.
